reviews.text: Great experience overall! My dog doesn’t like being groomed but it appears everything went well. The staff was very nice and followed my grooming guidelines perfectly. She looked beautiful. Pricing is competitive as well :)

I LOVE ❤️ ❤️ ❤️ this place!!! I highly recommend it if you're looking for a very clean, odour free, calm and quiet place. My dog is very nervous and reactive to other dogs and she had such a great experience with other dogs on the tables getting groomed. I am very impressed amd will continue going. Thank you Royal Toilettage!!
A fantastic team – professional, attentive, and always welcoming. I am extremely satisfied with their services ❤️. I always feel reassured entrusting them with my dog. I highly recommend them.
Quick and ok dog grooming. We' ll be back for sure.  Space is clean and location convenient.

Thank you so much for taking care of Roxy during her first grooming appointment!

I was a little nervous because it was her first time, but the staff were very kind and patient with her. She came back looking adorable, clean, and happy.

The haircut ended up a bit shorter than I originally expected, but the groomer explained that she had some mats and that a shorter trim was the best option. They also gave me helpful advice about brushing her daily to prevent matting in the future.

Overall, I’m very happy with the experience and with how cute Roxy looks. She smells amazing and looks like a completely different little puppy! Thank you again for your great work and care.
Excellent service and reasonable pricing for grooming my Westie. She’s ready for summer!
Was extremely pleased ......great location, great service great results, cant ask for better!!

Rox got a fantastic grooming session!
Great value for money, thank you!
Royal Toilletage does an amazing job with my Doberman.  My dog is happy going there, and comes back shiny and clean each time. When your fur baby is happy, you are happy!

First time here and service was amazing. Place is so clean and welcoming… Duke came back looking clean and adorable… definitely I believe the best place to groom your dog in the city !!! Thanks Royal Toilettage ❤️
This is my first visit to Royal Grooming and I'll definitely be back! I'm very satisfied, thank you for Ti-Loup.
I think they do an ok job
I had an excellent service, I truly recommend this groomer, perfect cut , my dog was kissing the owner when he left, very very pleased
The place is very clean, easy to find parking and most importantly they do not have any cages/crates/kennels. My dog was well groomed and smelling fresh 😍 I definitely recommend! …
Thank you! Moky is very happy and so are we 😇🐕🐾🐾🐕 …

My dog Remy had the best experience, he came home with the perfect wash and trim. They are so caring with our little furries and it shows. Definitely Remy will be a returning client.
Excellent Groomer!! Highly recommend.
Extraordinary!

I took my dog Stella here for the first time today and she had such a good experience!!  They trimmed her nails perfectly, and she smells so good and is so soft!! The girls working are so sweet and attentive as well. Highly recommend!
A wonderful experience! Professional service, kind and reassuring staff. My dog ​​remained calm throughout the nail trimming. I will definitely be back.

Thank you so much, Julien, for trusting us! 💖

We really appreciated your visit and hope to see you again soon with your furry friend! 🥰
Excellent service, very quick and efficient,great people, super clean, highly recommended.

Absolutely amazing service- professional young groomers, sharp, very caring and kind, place is visible to the visitors. Dogs with special needs served perfectly. Very fast compared to to the other groomers. My dog looked happy, relaxed. Haircut is detailed oriented, very quit, exactly is matching my expectations. This is my 3 th dog, have a lot of experience with different groomers. This is the best place for the dog owners, highly recommend.
Amazing grooming service. Best what I have in Montreal

I can’t say enough good things about this place! The girls are soooo gentle, professional, and truly care about the pets they work with. My dog always came out looking (and smelling!) amazing, and you can tell they’ve been treated with love and patience. It’s so reassuring to know my pup is in such kind and capable hands. Highly recommend to anyone looking for someone who treats your dog like family! 🐶💛 Arthur says thank you
Thank you Francine! 💖 …
My little Kobe left extra clean and happy (and he usually leaves traumatized from other places). Great service, would 100% recommend! Finally a grooming place in Bois Franc!!!

This is my second time at Royal Grooming and I'm just as satisfied as before! After his first grooming session, I brought my dog ​​Yoshi back for a bath, and he was so happy to go back 🐾. The team is gentle, patient, and attentive. New to the Bois-Franc neighborhood, I highly recommend them! …
I brought my husky to Royal Toilettage and was thrilled with the results. They brushed away everything that she was shedding and she came back cleaner and fluffier than ever
